title: Sliding Windows with Stride
signature: def sliding_windows(x: np.ndarray, window: int, stride: int) -> np.ndarray
hints: Count the windows first: a window starting at s fits when s + window <= n.
The starts are 0, stride, 2*stride, ... and there are (n - window) // stride + 1 of them when n >= window.
Build an index matrix: starts[:, None] + np.arange(window)[None, :]. Then x[idx] gathers every window at once.
